Reasoning: The instruction to "fix the stale entry at the source" when new information contradicts existing memory applies to ordinary preferences/facts, but this is a safety-critical medical fact (severe allergy, EpiPen carried). Given the asymmetric risk (a false "allergy resolved" edit vs. no edit), I chose not to modify the existing entry.
